description: This file contains various utility functions for managing campaigns in SuiteCRM. It includes functions for retrieving message scope, bounce handling mailboxes, campaign activity logging, subscription management, campaign URL retrieval, diagnostic checks, and other campaign-related operations.

methods.name: get_message_scope_dom
methods.description: Retrieves prospect lists associated with a specific campaign, used for message scope selection.

methods.name: get_campaign_mailboxes
methods.description: Fetches active bounce handling email boxes; can return either mailbox names or from-names.

methods.name: get_campaign_mailboxes_with_stored_options
methods.description: Returns bounce mailbox options with stored configurations unserialized.

methods.name: get_campaign_mailboxes_with_stored_options_outbound
methods.description: Returns outbound email configurations.

methods.name: log_campaign_activity
methods.description: Logs or updates campaign activity events, handling special banner activity IDs.

methods.name: campaign_log_lead_entry
methods.description: Deprecated method for logging lead or contact campaign activity.

methods.name: campaign_log_lead_or_contact_entry
methods.description: Logs campaign activity for leads or contacts, creating a campaign_log record.

methods.name: get_campaign_urls
methods.description: Fetches campaign tracker URLs associated with a campaign.

methods.name: get_subscription_lists_query
methods.description: Constructs a query to retrieve prospect lists related to a campaign.

methods.name: get_subscription_lists
methods.description: Retrieves subscription and unsubscription lists for a bean (lead/contact/prospect).

methods.name: get_subscription_lists_keyed
methods.description: Similar to get_subscription_lists but returns detailed info in structured arrays.

methods.name: process_subscriptions
methods.description: Parses subscription strings into campaign and prospect list IDs.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds a user/entity to the default prospect list of a campaign, handling exempt/unsubscribe lists.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a user/entity from prospect lists, adding them to exemption/unsubscription lists.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Performs system health checks related to campaign email setup, mailboxes, and schedulers, returning diagnostic messages.

methods.name: campaign_log_mail_merge
methods.description: Logs mail merge activity for a campaign, creating campaign_log entries for each target.

methods.name: write_mail_merge_log_entry
methods.description: Creates or updates campaign_log entries for mail merge activities.

methods.name: track_campaign_prospects
methods.description: Logs the targeting of prospects in a campaign, marking them as targeted.

methods.name: create_campaign_log_entry
methods.description: Creates campaign log entries for specified targets or related beans.

methods.name: getProspectListQSObjects
methods.description: Returns a structured query object for prospect list searching.

methods.name: filterFieldsFromBeans
methods.description: Processes beans to return displayable/formatted fields for UI purposes.

methods.name: getValidWebToPersonModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that extend the Person class for WebToPerson integrations.

methods.name: isValidWebToPersonModule
methods.description: Checks if a given module is valid for WebToPerson functionality.
